name: Fraternity
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred bond of fraternity among God's people, urging believers to avoid strife and recognize one another as brethren, as seen in Abram's plea to Lot for peace (Genesis 13:8). The law commands compassion and generosity toward fellow brethren in need, instructing believers not to harden their hearts but to give freely and joyfully, trusting in God's blessing for such obedience (Deuteronomy 15:7-10). These passages reveal that true fraternity involves both peaceful relationships and practical care, reflecting God's design for community grounded in love and mutual support.
